definition.en: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) is a comprehensive, long-term infrastructure investment plan designed to provide world-class infrastructure across India and improve the quality of life for all citizens.
definition.hi: The National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP) is a comprehensive, long-term infrastructure investment plan designed to provide world-class infrastructure across India and improve the quality of life for all citizens.

importanceInUpsc.en: NIP is a critical component of the GS-3 syllabus under the Indian Economy section, as it directly addresses the government's strategy for capital expenditure and economic growth. Understanding its implementation and funding mechanisms is essential for analyzing fiscal policy and infrastructure development in UPSC Mains.
